## Summary

Describe the change and its motivation.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Research experiment
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactoring

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Test suite run locally
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] Dataset/source/licensing information documented where applicable

## Research notes

For experiments, include dataset, split, seed, model/configuration, metrics, and relevant limitations.

## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets or credentials committed
- [ ] Changes are focused and reproducible
